_comment: Dev commands for the second client (multiplayer test, served on port 8081; see dev_commands.json for the actions). Bump revision to run them. Recipe: join the host's listen server the way dustUnreal does after OnBattleMemberConnect (in-battle location, then CleanLoad <address>:<port>?credential=...?Team=...). The credential must match the host's battle_member command in dev_commands.json.
